           TRIBULUS TERRESTRIS

         Ikshugandha


An East Indian drug useful in urinary affections, especially dysuria, and
        in debilitated states of the sexual organs, as expressed in seminal weakness, ready
        emissions and impoverished semen. Prostatitis, calculous affections and sexual neurasthenia.
        It meets the auto-traumatism of masturbation correcting the emissions and spermatorrhœa.
        Partial impotence caused by overindulgence of advancing age, or when accompanied by urinary
        symptoms, incontinence, painful micturition, etc.



Dose.--  Ten to twenty drops of the tincture three times daily.
